_comment: Haunted-land grass/cobble blob-autotile (grass dominant, cobble intrudes) - the complementary orientation to haunted_cobble_grass.json. Row-major: 0=grass 1=grass_cobble_n 2=grass_cobble_s 3=grass_cobble_e 4=grass_cobble_w 5=grass_cobble_nw 6=grass_cobble_ne 7=grass_cobble_sw 8=grass_cobble_se 9=cobble(pure). Shares its pure grass/cobble tiles with haunted_cobble_grass.json for a seamless border between the two.
